correctness.rationale: For a bouquet with at least two petals the hub is the unique degree>=3 vertex and is definable with four variable names. Removing it gives paths; recursive three-place distance formulas distinguish exact lengths with four total variable names after safe alpha-renaming/shadowing. k simultaneous representatives distinguish counts through k; the indefinite k-pebble partial isomorphism pairs occupied paths by length and always has a spare equivalent path if counts are >=k. This establishes both directions at unrestricted depth. Finite L count (k+1)^|L|-|L|-1 excludes zero and single-petal vectors; the clipped bouquet is the unique minimum; k vs k+1 triangles gives strictness. Inspected verify_cycle_bouquets.py implements finite tuple-refinement color sets as corroboration, not the all-depth proof.
